text: The authors find that, after controlling for the accuracy gap, weak supervisor and strong student similarity is inversely correlated with weak-to-strong gain (r = -0.35, p < 0.01). They state that this contributes towards understanding why weak-to-strong gains vary across tasks, an open question posed by Burns et al. (2024).
title: Goel et al. link weak-to-strong gain to low model similarity, addressing a Burns et al. open question
